controls.attack: a small app change outside every locked path
a docs change outside the design rules
a change to a test that holds no control
a change to an app's own src/ (the engine's source locks stand aside in a managed app)
a planned task whose PR changes only what its plan lists
a new test, with the change read for a weakened test, lint or guard
a small app change outside every locked path, decided by the coordinator's own mergeDecisionFor
a small app change the evaluator passed, then the harness merged the default branch into it (a merge-in)
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-merge-in-rejection-carried: the PASS is carried across the merge-in, and the change is measured from the merged default branch)

controls.attack: a small app change while the default branch has moved past the PR's base with an unrelated commit
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-default-branch-marked-table-grown: a moved tip alone holds nothing)

controls.attack: a small app change whose branch merged the moved default branch in itself (an unrelated commit there)
controls.source: the suite's own control (default-branch-tip.json: a tip merged in by the PR alone holds nothing)

controls.attack: a stale PR that only adds a rule to a test the default branch marked as a lint test after this PR's base
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-default-branch-lint-mark: only a rule taken out of a lint test marked on the tip holds it)

controls.attack: a lint test made on the default branch after this PR's base; the PR merges the default branch in, then only adds a rule to it
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-default-branch-lint-file-only-at-tip: only a rule taken out of a tip-only lint test holds it)

controls.attack: a stale PR (it never merged the default branch in) that edits a file elsewhere, beside a table the default branch marked never-shrink since
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-default-branch-mark-taken-out-after-merge: a head older than the mark keeps it through the merge)

controls.attack: a planned task whose PR changes an auth file its plan lists, in a repo whose review.yaml puts auth at L2
controls.source: the suite's own control (flow-outside-plan-auth-not-held: only the plan check holds that case)
